newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo Nordisk sees 15 pct better '97.
newsitem.headline: Novo Nordisk sees 15 pct better '97.

text.p: Danish pharmaceuticals and biotechnology group Novo Nordisk A/S said on Wednesday it expected to achieve a 15 percent improvement in operating profits in 1997.

"We also expect a 15 percent better pre-tax result this year, conditional on the performance of international currency and securities markets," Novo Nordisk said in a statement accompanying its 1996 result.

The group posted a 1996 pre-tax profit of 2.521 billion crowns ($386.7 million), 17 percent up on the previous year on eight percent higher consolidated turnover of 14.873 billion crowns. ($ = 6.52 Danish Crowns)
